violation_type.title: Specialized Medical Assistance - Provide as Recommended or Ordered by a Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §744.2665(a))
violation_type.short_title: Specialized Medical Assistance - Provide as Recommended or Ordered by a Health-Care Professional
violation_type.typical_finding: A child enrolled at the operation has a food allergy, and an emergency food allergy plan on file, and this allergy requires an epi pen, however the operation does not have an epi pen for the child in their possession.     Operation given until 01/03/2022 to have epi pen on hand for the child due to the operation closing for Christmas break 12/17/2022-01/03/2022.
